outputs.explanation: Panel A shows stacked horizontal bars depicting the fixed time breakdown (camera exposure vs illumination overhead) for each input setting, with a single deterministic percentage per condition rather than an average of biological replicates. There is no underlying variability to display as individual points.
Panel B is a line plot of photobleaching decay curves with shaded s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Panel C is a scatter plot (ΔROS vs exposure time) with a fitted trend line; scatter plots inherently show individual data values and are exempt.
Panel D shows line plots of individual cell migration tracks; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel E is a bar chart of mean migration speed with individual data points (dots for each cell) overlaid on the bars, satisfying the requirement.
Panel F consists of micrograph images (Mitotracker, Paxillin, Merge); it is not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel G is a time-series of micrograph images, not a plot showing averages.
Panel H is a time-series of micrograph images, not a plot showing averages.
Panel I is a line plot of normalized cell area over time with error bars (mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel J is a line plot of normalized mitochondrial area over time with error bars (mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
